svg.text: Openpress — UML Architecture: MVC Request / Response Flow
Plugins: CORS · Compression · DefaultHeaders · CallId · ContentNeg · JWT · Sessions
How routing identifies a module and dispatches to the appropriate controller:
1. URL pattern matches in Router (e.g. POST /cities → matches post("/cities"))
2. Router invokes the matching handler function (Controller) 3. Controller deserializes JSON body via ContentNegotiation 4. Controller calls Service 5. Service returns Model
Example: POST /cities — Create a new City (full lifecycle)
⨯ 401 Unauthorized — JWT missing or invalid → authentication plugin rejects
⨯ 404 Not Found — Route matches but resource missing → call.respond(NotFound)
🗺️ Complete Route Table — URL → Controller → Service Mapping
